pNone_chapter_1: A sun-drenched room in a traditional Bengali house features a large window where Ajit, a stocky man in a white dhoti-kurta, sits in a wooden chair reading a newspaper. The golden morning light of early February illuminates dust motes in the air and highlights a vintage black rotary telephone resting on a nearby side table. In the background, the room is filled with dark wood furniture and stacks of books, creating a quiet, intellectual atmosphere. Ajit is captured in the moment of looking up from his paper toward the ringing telephone, his expression one of focused curiosity.
